subject.title: fix(hooks): bound HOOK.md reads during hook install validation

question: Should installable hook metadata intentionally require a stable regular file no larger than 1 MiB?
rationale: The implementation correctly closes the memory-exhaustion path, but the selected security primitive also tightens accepted package inputs beyond byte bounding alone, which requires owner intent.

options.title: Approve the strict boundary
options.body: Keep the shared safety primitive and treat oversized, symlinked, non-regular, or changing hook metadata as invalid install input.

options.title: Preserve file-kind compatibility
options.body: Use a chunked byte-bounded reader that prevents unbounded allocation without adding regular-file and identity restrictions.

recommendation.title: Approve the strict boundary
recommendation.body: Keep the shared safety primitive and treat oversized, symlinked, non-regular, or changing hook metadata as invalid install input.
